czech: Viděl jsi ten film? Ano, viděl jsem.
english: Had you seen the movie? Yes, I had.
Had he lost his keys? No, he hadn't.

czech: Už jste začali? Ano, začali jsme.
english: Had you already started? Yes, we had.

czech: Oni koupili nový dům? Ne, nekoupili.
english: Had they bought a new house? No, they hadn't.

czech: Četl jsi tu knihu? Ano, četl jsem.
english: Had you read the book? Yes, I had.
Had she written a letter? No, she hadn't.

czech: Byl jsi v Londýně? Ano, byl jsem.
english: Had you been to London? Yes, I had.

czech: Jedl jsi snídani? Ne, nejedl jsem.
english: Had you eaten breakfast? No, I hadn't.
